TITLE: Workspace integration
UNAVAILABLE: The connected workspace integration is not switched on for this installation. Its operator can switch it on in the server configuration; until then nothing is sent to the connected workspace.
ERROR: The connected workspace integration could not be loaded. Please try again.
READY: The connected workspace integration is switched on for this installation.
INTRO: Connect this organization to an organization in the connected workspace with an integration key (it starts with ew_int_). Tasks, teams, goals, missions, ideas, agents, docs and the inbox then sync in both directions.
CONNECT_SOON: Connecting from this page arrives with the next release of the integration.
CREATE_KEY: Create an integration key in the connected workspace
VERSIONS: Plugin {{ plugin }}, connected workspace integration contract v{{ contract }}
CHECKING: Checking the connection of this organization…

CONNECTED.TITLE: This organization syncs with the connected workspace organization {{ name }}.
CONNECTED.INACTIVE: The connection is {{ status }}: nothing syncs until it is resumed or gets a new key. Open the sync settings to fix it.

KEY.TITLE: Create an integration key in the connected workspace
KEY.STEP_1: In the connected workspace, open Settings → API keys → New key and choose the type Integration (the link below opens it with the "Base360" preset).
KEY.STEP_2: Name the key, for example "Base360 — {{ organization }}".
KEY.STEP_3: Pin the key to the connected workspace organizations to sync.
KEY.STEP_5: Copy the key: it is shown once and starts with ew_int_.
KEY.NO_APP_URL: Open the connected workspace and go to Settings → API keys.

CONNECT.API_URL_HINT: The API address of the connected workspace, ending in /api (for example https://<your API host>/api). Self-hosted, stage and dev addresses work too (HTTPS, no query or fragment).
CONNECT.KEY_HINT: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
CONNECT.MISSING_SCOPES: The key lacks these scopes of the "Base360" preset; what they cover does not sync: {{ scopes }}
CONNECT.MISSING_REQUIRED: The key lacks scopes the connection cannot work without: {{ scopes }}. Create a key with the "Base360" preset.
CONNECT.INCOMPATIBLE: The connected workspace uses integration API v{{ version }}; this Base360 installation uses another version. Nothing can be connected.
CONNECT.EXISTING: This tenant is already connected to the connected workspace tenant {{ tenant }} (key {{ key }}).
CONNECT.STATUS_NOT_ACTIVE: The connection is {{ status }}: resume it, use a new key or disconnect below, then map this organization.

ORGANIZATION.TITLE: Map this organization to one of the key's pinned connected workspace organizations.
ORGANIZATION.NONE_PINNED: The key is pinned to no connected workspace organization.

REVIEW.INTRO: Only a shared Base360 account pairs people by itself: confirm the suggestions, pair by hand, or leave a record unpaired.
REVIEW.INITIATIVES_INTRO: Missions in the connected workspace sync with Base360 strategic initiatives. A mission created from a Base360 initiative starts paused (only the connected workspace starts its work), a draft initiative goes to the connected workspace once it is active, and leadership initiatives never sync.
REVIEW.INITIATIVES_UNAVAILABLE: Pairing initiatives with missions is not available on this installation yet.
REVIEW.INITIATIVE_DRAFT: draft: goes to the connected workspace once it is active
REVIEW.MISSIONS_ONE_WAY: Initiatives are created in the connected workspace only when Missions ↔ Initiatives syncs both ways (Entities and directions).
REVIEW.TEAMS_ONE_WAY: Base360 teams are created in the connected workspace only when Teams syncs to the connected workspace (Entities and directions).
REVIEW.MAPPING_OFF_NO_CREATE: Switch the mapping on to create records on the other side.
REVIEW.DEFERRED_INBOX: Inbox items waiting for a pairing
REVIEW.DEFERRED_INBOX_HINT: Connected workspace addressed these inbox items to members who are not paired with a Base360 person yet, so they were not delivered. Pair the member above and their items arrive in their Base360 Inbox.
REVIEW.AGENTS_INTRO: Connected workspace agents become Base360 employees of kind "agent" when the sync starts. They are managed by the connected workspace: edits made in Base360 are not pushed.
REVIEW.PROJECTS_UNAVAILABLE: Pairing projects with works is not available on this installation yet.
REVIEW.DUPLICATE_CHOICE: The same Base360 record is chosen for two connected workspace records. Choose it for one of them only.

INVITE.GAUZY_PENDING: Invited to Base360: the invitation is pending
INVITE.GAUZY_PEOPLE: Base360 people with no connected workspace member
INVITE.CONFIRM_EVER_WORKS_TITLE: Invite this person to the connected workspace?
INVITE.ORGANIZATION_GAUZY: The Base360 organization this mapping syncs
INVITE.ORGANIZATION_EVER_WORKS: The connected workspace organization this mapping syncs
INVITE.ROLE_EMPLOYEE: Employee (the role whose acceptance creates a person to pair; change it in Base360 once they have joined)
INVITE.ROLE_MEMBER: Member (an owner of the connected workspace promotes members)
INVITE.CONFIRM_GAUZY_HINT: Base360 sends its invitation email. Nothing is paired: once they join, their verified email suggests the pairing here.
INVITE.CONFIRM_EVER_WORKS_HINT: The connected workspace sends its invitation email, as your paired user in that workspace (or the integration key owner). Nothing is paired: once they join, pair them here.

RESULT.pending: An invitation is already pending; nothing was sent again
RESULT.already_member: Already a member of the connected workspace organization: pair them above
RESULT.added: Added to the connected workspace organization: pair them above

DIRECTIONS.INTRO: Choose what syncs and in which direction. Records that are private in the connected workspace never sync.
DIRECTIONS.SYNC_UNLINKED_PROJECT_TASKS: Also sync tasks of projects that are not paired with a work
DIRECTIONS.OFF_BY_SYNC_SETTING: Not synced: the sync setting of this record type is off for the mapping.

DOMAINS.agentEmail: Agent email (a read-only copy in the Inbox)

PREVIEW.INTRO: A dry run: what the first sync reads, pairs and creates. Nothing is written until you start it.
PREVIEW.WEBHOOK_NOT_REGISTERED: The connected workspace could not register its webhook ({{ reason }}); the change feed keeps the sync going.

SETTINGS.NOT_FOUND: This page belongs to a connected workspace mapping of another organization, or to one that no longer exists. Select its organization, or connect this one.
SETTINGS.BACK_TO_CONNECT: Open the connected workspace page of this organization

CONNECTION_STATE.paused: The connection is paused: nothing is read from or sent to the connected workspace until it is resumed.
CONNECTION_STATE.needs_reauth: Connected workspace no longer accepts the integration key (revoked or expired). Enter a new key in Advanced.
CONNECTION_STATE.error: The last health check of the connection failed; see the error below.

SETTINGS.QUEUE: {{ pending }} pending, {{ deferred }} deferred, {{ failed }} retrying, {{ dead }} stopped
SETTINGS.RUN_CANCELLED: The sync was cancelled; what it applied stays.
SETTINGS.FIRST_SYNC: This organization has not synced yet
SETTINGS.USED_OTHER: The other value was written and is being synced.
SETTINGS.ENABLED: Sync this organization with the connected workspace
SETTINGS.ENABLED_ON: Syncing is on for this organization.
SETTINGS.ENABLED_OFF: Syncing is off for this organization; nothing is read or sent until it is on again.
SETTINGS.KEY_CURRENT: Current key: {{ name }} ({{ prefix }}). A new key must belong to the same connected workspace tenant; the old one keeps working until the connected workspace retires it.
SETTINGS.KEY_ROTATED: The new key is in use.
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_HINT: Disconnecting stops the sync for every organization of this tenant and removes the connected workspace webhook. Synced data stays on both sides, and the pairings are kept for a reconnect.
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_WEBHOOK_KEPT: Disconnected, but the connected workspace could not delete the webhook subscription, so it may keep sending events (Base360 refuses them). Revoke the integration key in the connected workspace (Settings → API keys), which disables its webhooks. Reconnecting to the same connected workspace tenant tries to delete it again.
